parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile effective viewport
upstream_facts: The upstream mobile snapshot was extracted at 375x240 CSS px.
fret_facts: The native diagnostics script must prove the effective layout root is 375x240 before comparing drawer geometry.
On the current Windows native runner, requesting a 375x220 surface produces the required 375x240 effective layout root.

checks.expected: The Fret sidecar root should be the same 375x240 viewport used by the upstream DOM snapshot.

promotion.reason: Viewport drift must be caught as diagnostics-surface evidence before component or mechanism geometry is compared.

parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile trigger size
upstream_facts: The responsive demo trigger stays a 150px outline button.
The constrained viewport still keeps the trigger on the h-9 lane.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery demo exposes a stable responsive combobox trigger selector.
The responsive shell is recipe-owned and stays on the explicit `device_shell_responsive(true)` lane.

checks.expected: The mobile responsive trigger should remain 150px wide and 36px tall.

promotion.reason: This is a recipe-owned sizing invariant for the responsive demo trigger.

parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile drawer shell surface
upstream_facts: Mobile open state switches to the Drawer-backed surface.
The drawer content shell should use the upstream bottom-sheet max-h-[80vh] lane rather than an extra hard edge-gap clamp.
fret_facts: The responsive demo exposes a stable drawer content-shell selector for the open panel.
The command/listbox subtree can be correct while the bottom-sheet shell itself is too short.

checks.expected: Mobile drawer shell should span the viewport width and be about 192px tall in the 375x240 upstream snapshot.

promotion.reason: Drawer shell height drift crosses DrawerContent max-height policy, viewport negotiation, and child overflow handling.

parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile command wrapper surface
upstream_facts: The mobile docs-path demo wraps StatusList in a mt-4 border-t div inside DrawerContent.
That wrapper starts about 41px below the drawer shell top after the drag handle and margin.
fret_facts: The responsive recipe exposes a stable command-wrapper selector.
Relative wrapper placement is a better oracle than absolute window containment for bottom sheets.

checks.expected: Mobile command wrapper should be about 41px below the drawer shell top and around 205px tall.

promotion.reason: The wrapper is a docs-path responsive recipe composition invariant.

parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile command root surface
upstream_facts: The command root fills the wrapper content width.
Command root height is the 36px input wrapper plus the 168px listbox.
fret_facts: The Fret Command root has its own stable selector so command sizing can be evaluated separately from the drawer shell.
A passing command root with a failing drawer shell isolates the drift to shell sizing.

checks.expected: Mobile command root should stay around 204px tall and start just below the wrapper border.

promotion.reason: Command root sizing is recipe-owned once drawer shell sizing is separated.

parts.label: Responsive combobox mobile listbox surface
upstream_facts: The command listbox is 168px tall for five 32px items plus group padding.
The listbox starts below the 36px input wrapper.
fret_facts: The responsive demo exposes a stable listbox selector.
Listbox height can pass even when the outer drawer shell is too short.

checks.expected: Mobile listbox should stay 168px tall and roughly 36px below the command root.

promotion.reason: Listbox sizing is a Command recipe invariant.

limitations: This slice measures the constrained 375x240 open state of the shadcn responsive combobox demo.
Fret layout sidecar abs_rect values are logical px and compare directly against upstream DOM CSS px.
This slice separates drawer shell sizing from inner command-wrapper, command, and listbox sizing so bottom-sheet shell drift does not hide command parity.
